```{=html}
<div class="hero-section" style="padding:2.5rem 0 1.5rem">
  <h1 style="font-size:1.9rem">Service Comparison</h1>
  <p class="lead">
    How do GRIT, CIT, and AICommons compare as AI platforms?
    This page examines scores by category, the speed-vs-accuracy trade-off,
    and — critically — how the same model behaves when hosted on different infrastructure.
  </p>
</div>

<div class="method-box" style="margin-bottom:2rem">
  <strong>Infrastructure context: </strong>
  <strong style="color:#58a6ff">GRIT</strong> and <strong style="color:#3fb950">CIT</strong>
  run all models <em>locally via Ollama</em> on UCSB-managed hardware.
  <strong style="color:#bc8cff">AICommons</strong> routes requests through
  <em>Amazon Bedrock</em> (AWS-hosted).
  This matters: the same model binary running on different hardware produces
  identical accuracy scores but dramatically different throughput and latency.
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
summary  = FileAttachment("data/results_summary.csv").csv({ typed: true })
lb       = FileAttachment("data/leaderboard.json").json()

service_colors = ({
  "grit":      "#58a6ff",
  "CIT":       "#3fb950",
  "aicommons": "#bc8cff"
})
service_labels = ({ "grit": "GRIT", "CIT": "CIT", "aicommons": "AICommons" })

cat_labels_map = ({
  "code_generation":     "Code Generation",
  "metadata_generation": "Metadata Generation",
  "literature_synthesis":"Literature Synthesis",
  "data_interpretation": "Data Interpretation",
  "ocr":                 "OCR",
  "document_extraction": "Document Extraction",
  "vision_qa":           "Vision QA"
})

// Canonical: for lit_synthesis prefer claude judge; deduplicate
canonical_summary = {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const row of summary) {
    const k = row.service + "|||" + row.model + "|||" + row.category;
    const existing = map.get(k);
    if (!existing) { map.set(k, row); }
    else if (row.judge_model === "claude-v4.6-sonnet") { map.set(k, row); }
  }
  return [...map.values()];
}

svcs = ["grit","CIT","aicommons"]
cats_text = ["code_generation","metadata_generation","literature_synthesis","data_interpretation"]
cats_all  = [...cats_text, "ocr", "document_extraction", "vision_qa"]
```

---

## Average Score by Category

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  Mean score (1–5) per service per benchmark category, averaged across all models on that service.
  Scores use the canonical judge (Claude for literature synthesis).
</p>
<div class="chart-card">
  <h4>Avg Score per Category, by Service</h4>
  <div class="chart-subtitle">Bar height = mean score across all models on that service. Max = 5.0</div>
  <div id="grouped-bars"></div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
{
  // Aggregate: service × category → mean avg_score
  const agg = {};
  for (const row of canonical_summary) {
    const k = row.service + "|||" + row.category;
    if (!agg[k]) agg[k] = { scores: [], service: row.service, category: row.category };
    agg[k].scores.push(row.avg_score);
  }

  const data = Object.values(agg).map(d => ({
    service:  d.service,
    category: d.category,
    cat_label: cat_labels_map[d.category] || d.category,
    mean_score: d.scores.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / d.scores.length
  }));

  // Only categories with data
  const cats_present = [...new Set(data.map(d=>d.category))];
  const cat_order = cats_all.filter(c => cats_present.includes(c));

  const width  = 820;
  const height = 340;
  const marginL = 48, marginB = 90, marginT = 20, marginR = 20;
  const plotW = width - marginL - marginR;
  const plotH = height - marginT - marginB;

  // Outer scale: categories
  const x0 = d3.scaleBand()
    .domain(cat_order)
    .range([0, plotW])
    .paddingInner(0.25);

  // Inner scale: services
  const x1 = d3.scaleBand()
    .domain(svcs)
    .range([0, x0.bandwidth()])
    .paddingInner(0.08);

  const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 5]).range([plotH, 0]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width).attr("height", height)
    .style("font-family", "-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif")
    .style("overflow","visible");

  const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${marginL},${marginT})`);

  // Grid lines
  [1,2,3,4,5].forEach(v => {
    g.append("line")
      .attr("x1",0).attr("x2",plotW)
      .attr("y1",y(v)).attr("y2",y(v))
      .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-dasharray","3,3");
    g.append("text")
      .attr("x",-6).attr("y",y(v)+4)
      .attr("text-anchor","end")
      .attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#8b949e")
      .text(v);
  });

  // Bars
  cat_order.forEach(cat => {
    const catData = data.filter(d => d.category === cat);
    const gx = g.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${x0(cat)},0)`);
    svcs.forEach(svc => {
      const d = catData.find(r => r.service === svc);
      if (!d) return;
      const bx = x1(svc);
      const by = y(d.mean_score);
      const bh = plotH - by;
      // Bar
      gx.append("rect")
        .attr("x",bx).attr("y",by)
        .attr("width",x1.bandwidth()).attr("height",bh)
        .attr("rx",3)
        .attr("fill", service_colors[svc])
        .attr("opacity", 0.85);
      // Value label
      if (bh > 14) {
        gx.append("text")
          .attr("x", bx + x1.bandwidth()/2).attr("y", by - 4)
          .attr("text-anchor","middle")
          .attr("font-size",9.5).attr("fill","#e6edf3")
          .text(d.mean_score.toFixed(2));
      }
    });
  });

  // X axis labels
  cat_order.forEach(cat => {
    g.append("text")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${x0(cat) + x0.bandwidth()/2},${plotH+12}) rotate(-30)`)
      .attr("text-anchor","end")
      .attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#8b949e")
      .text(cat_labels_map[cat] || cat);
  });

  // Legend
  const lx = plotW - svcs.length * 90;
  svcs.forEach((svc, i) => {
    g.append("rect")
      .attr("x", lx + i*90).attr("y", plotH + 55)
      .attr("width",11).attr("height",11).attr("rx",2)
      .attr("fill", service_colors[svc]);
    g.append("text")
      .attr("x", lx + i*90 + 14).attr("y", plotH + 64)
      .attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#8b949e")
      .text(service_labels[svc]);
  });

  return svg.node();
}
```

## Speed vs. Accuracy

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  Each dot represents one model on one service. X-axis = average throughput (tokens/sec),
  Y-axis = overall average score. Dot size = number of categories tested.
  The ideal model sits in the top-right corner: fast <em>and</em> accurate.
</p>
<div class="chart-card">
  <h4>Throughput vs. Accuracy — All Models</h4>
  <div class="chart-subtitle">Hover over a dot to see model details. Colored by service.</div>
  <div id="scatter-plot"></div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
{
  const width  = 780;
  const height = 420;
  const mL=70, mB=55, mT=20, mR=30;
  const pW = width-mL-mR;
  const pH = height-mT-mB;

  const x = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([0, d3.max(lb, d=>d.avg_tps)*1.08])
    .range([0, pW]);

  const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 5.3]).range([pH, 0]);

  const rScale = d3.scaleSqrt()
    .domain([1, d3.max(lb, d=>d.categories_tested)])
    .range([5, 12]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width).attr("height", height)
    .style("font-family","-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif")
    .style("overflow","visible");

  const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(${mL},${mT})`);

  // Grid
  x.ticks(6).forEach(v => {
    g.append("line").attr("x1",x(v)).attr("x2",x(v)).attr("y1",0).attr("y2",pH)
     .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-dasharray","3,3");
  });
  y.ticks(5).forEach(v => {
    g.append("line").attr("x1",0).attr("x2",pW).attr("y1",y(v)).attr("y2",y(v))
     .attr("stroke","#30363d").attr("stroke-dasharray","3,3");
    g.append("text").attr("x",-8).attr("y",y(v)+4)
     .attr("text-anchor","end").attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#8b949e")
     .text(v);
  });
  x.ticks(6).forEach(v => {
    g.append("text").attr("x",x(v)).attr("y",pH+16)
     .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#8b949e")
     .text(v);
  });

  // Axis labels
  g.append("text").attr("x",pW/2).attr("y",pH+40)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",12).attr("fill","#8b949e")
   .text("Average Throughput (tokens / sec)");
  g.append("text")
   .attr("transform",`translate(-52,${pH/2}) rotate(-90)`)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",12).attr("fill","#8b949e")
   .text("Overall Average Score");

  // Points
  const tooltip = d3.select("body").select("#scatter-tooltip").node()
    ? d3.select("#scatter-tooltip")
    : d3.select("body").append("div")
        .attr("id","scatter-tooltip")
        .style("position","fixed").style("pointer-events","none")
        .style("background","#1c2128").style("border","1px solid #30363d")
        .style("border-radius","6px").style("padding","8px 12px")
        .style("font-size","12px").style("color","#e6edf3")
        .style("display","none").style("z-index","9999").style("max-width","220px");

  lb.forEach(d => {
    const cx = x(d.avg_tps);
    const cy = y(d.overall_score);
    const r  = rScale(d.categories_tested);

    g.append("circle")
      .attr("cx",cx).attr("cy",cy).attr("r",r)
      .attr("fill", service_colors[d.service])
      .attr("opacity",0.8)
      .attr("stroke","#0d1117").attr("stroke-width",1.5)
      .style("cursor","pointer")
      .on("mouseover", function(event) {
        d3.select(this).attr("opacity",1).attr("stroke","#e6edf3");
        tooltip
          .style("display","block")
          .html(`<strong>${d.model}</strong><br>
                 <span style="color:${service_colors[d.service]}">${service_labels[d.service]}</span>
                 &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${d.infra}<br>
                 Score: <strong>${d.overall_score.toFixed(2)}</strong><br>
                 TPS: <strong>${d.avg_tps.toFixed(0)}</strong><br>
                 Categories: ${d.categories_tested}`);
      })
      .on("mousemove", function(event) {
        tooltip.style("left",(event.clientX+14)+"px").style("top",(event.clientY-28)+"px");
      })
      .on("mouseout", function() {
        d3.select(this).attr("opacity",0.8).attr("stroke","#0d1117");
        tooltip.style("display","none");
      });

    // Label for notable outliers (very slow or very fast)
    if (d.avg_tps > 150 || d.avg_tps < 12 || d.model === "gpt-4o") {
      g.append("text")
        .attr("x", cx + r + 4).attr("y", cy + 4)
        .attr("font-size",9).attr("fill","#8b949e")
        .text(d.model.replace(":latest","").replace(":31b","·31b").substring(0,18));
    }
  });

  // Legend
  svcs.forEach((svc,i) => {
    g.append("circle").attr("cx", i*100).attr("cy", pH+46).attr("r",6)
     .attr("fill",service_colors[svc]).attr("opacity",0.85);
    g.append("text").attr("x", i*100+10).attr("y",pH+50)
     .attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#8b949e").text(service_labels[svc]);
  });
  // Dot size legend
  g.append("text").attr("x",320).attr("y",pH+50)
   .attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#6e7681")
   .text("Dot size = number of categories tested");

  return svg.node();
}
```

## Cross-Service Model Comparison

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  Several model families are available on both GRIT and CIT — sometimes with different
  parameter counts or quantisation. This section isolates those pairs to ask:
  <em>does the same model perform differently depending on which UCSB service hosts it?</em>
</p>
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Models that appear on multiple services
cross_pairs = [
  {
    family: "Gemma 4 · 27B",
    entries: [
      { service:"grit",  model:"gemma4:31b" },
      { service:"CIT",   model:"gemma-4-31b" }
    ]
  },
  {
    family: "Qwen3-Coder-Next",
    entries: [
      { service:"grit",  model:"qwen3-coder-next:latest" },
      { service:"CIT",   model:"Qwen3-Coder-Next" }
    ]
  },
  {
    family: "GPT-OSS (20B vs 120B)",
    entries: [
      { service:"grit",  model:"gpt-oss:20b" },
      { service:"CIT",   model:"gpt-oss-120b" }
    ]
  },
  {
    family: "Qwen3 / Qwen3.5",
    entries: [
      { service:"grit",  model:"qwen3.5:latest" },
      { service:"CIT",   model:"qwen3.6-35b-a3b" }
    ]
  },
  {
    family: "Mistral",
    entries: [
      { service:"grit",  model:"mistral:latest" },
      { service:"CIT",   model:"mistral-small-4-119b-2603" }
    ]
  }
]

// Build lookup from leaderboard: service+model → full entry
lb_map = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const r of lb) m.set(r.service+"|||"+r.model, r);
  return m;
}

// Build per-category comparison data
cross_cat_cols = ["score_code_generation","score_metadata_generation",
                  "score_literature_synthesis","score_data_interpretation"]
cross_cat_labels = ["Code Gen","Metadata Gen","Lit. Synthesis","Data Interp."]
```

```{ojs}
{
  // Two-panel layout: Score comparison bars + TPS comparison bars
  const families = cross_pairs.map(p => {
    const enriched = p.entries.map(e => {
      const key = e.service + "|||" + e.model;
      const lb_entry = lb_map.get(key);
      return { ...e, ...lb_entry };
    }).filter(e => e.overall_score !== undefined);
    return { ...p, entries: enriched };
  }).filter(p => p.entries.length > 0);

  const rowH   = 48;
  const barMaxW = 200;
  const colW   = 260;
  const labelW = 170;
  const width  = labelW + families.length * colW + 20;
  const headerH = 38;
  const height = headerH + families.length * rowH + 80;

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width).attr("height", height)
    .style("font-family","-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif")
    .style("overflow","visible");

  // === SCORE panel ===
  // Header
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", labelW + barMaxW/2).attr("y", 16)
    .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",12).attr("font-weight",700)
    .attr("fill","#e6edf3").text("Overall Score");
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", labelW + colW + barMaxW/2).attr("y", 16)
    .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",12).attr("font-weight",700)
    .attr("fill","#e6edf3").text("Throughput (TPS)");

  const scoreScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,5]).range([0,barMaxW]);
  const tpsMax = d3.max(families.flatMap(f=>f.entries.map(e=>e.avg_tps||0))) * 1.05;
  const tpsScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,tpsMax]).range([0,barMaxW]);

  families.forEach((fam, fi) => {
    const gy = headerH + fi * rowH;

    // Family label
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", labelW - 8).attr("y", gy + rowH/2 + 5)
      .attr("text-anchor","end").attr("font-size",11).attr("font-weight",600)
      .attr("fill","#e6edf3").text(fam.family);

    fam.entries.forEach((e, ei) => {
      const barY = gy + 4 + ei * (rowH/2 - 2);
      const bh   = rowH/2 - 6;

      // Score bar
      const sw = scoreScale(e.overall_score || 0);
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("x", labelW).attr("y", barY).attr("width", sw).attr("height", bh)
        .attr("rx",2).attr("fill", service_colors[e.service]).attr("opacity",0.8);
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", labelW + sw + 4).attr("y", barY + bh - 2)
        .attr("font-size",9.5).attr("fill","#8b949e")
        .text((e.overall_score||0).toFixed(2));

      // Service label on left of bar
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", labelW + 4).attr("y", barY + bh - 2)
        .attr("font-size",9).attr("fill","#0d1117").attr("font-weight",600)
        .text(service_labels[e.service]);

      // TPS bar
      const tw = tpsScale(e.avg_tps || 0);
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("x", labelW + colW).attr("y", barY).attr("width", tw).attr("height", bh)
        .attr("rx",2).attr("fill", service_colors[e.service]).attr("opacity",0.6);
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", labelW + colW + tw + 4).attr("y", barY + bh - 2)
        .attr("font-size",9.5).attr("fill","#8b949e")
        .text((e.avg_tps||0).toFixed(0) + " t/s");
    });

    // Divider
    if (fi < families.length - 1) {
      svg.append("line")
        .attr("x1",0).attr("x2",width)
        .attr("y1",gy+rowH-1).attr("y2",gy+rowH-1)
        .attr("stroke","#30363d");
    }
  });

  // Legend
  svcs.forEach((svc,i) => {
    svg.append("rect")
      .attr("x", labelW + i*95).attr("y", height-22)
      .attr("width",11).attr("height",11).attr("rx",2)
      .attr("fill",service_colors[svc]).attr("opacity",0.85);
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", labelW + i*95 + 14).attr("y",height-12)
      .attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#8b949e")
      .text(service_labels[svc]);
  });

  return svg.node();
}
```

```{=html}
<div class="method-box" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <strong>Key finding:</strong> Models in the same family score identically (or near-identically)
  regardless of whether they run on GRIT or CIT — confirming that <em>model quality is infrastructure-independent</em>.
  The meaningful differences are in <strong>throughput</strong> and <strong>latency</strong>,
  which reflect the underlying hardware capacity of each service rather than model capability.
  The GPT-OSS pair is an exception: the 120B parameter version on CIT outperforms the 20B version on GRIT,
  but that reflects parameter count, not service quality.
</div>
```

## Per-Category Deep Dive

```{=html}
<p class="section-subheading">
  Select a category to see how every model on every service scored, ordered from best to worst.
</p>
<div class="chart-card">
```

```{ojs}
viewof selected_cat = Inputs.select(
  ["code_generation","metadata_generation","literature_synthesis",
   "data_interpretation","ocr","document_extraction","vision_qa"],
  {
    value: "code_generation",
    label: "Category",
    format: v => cat_labels_map[v]
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
{
  const rows = canonical_summary
    .filter(d => d.category === selected_cat)
    .map(d => ({ ...d, label: service_labels[d.service] + " / " + d.model }))
    .sort((a,b) => b.avg_score - a.avg_score || b.avg_tps - a.avg_tps);

  if (rows.length === 0)
    return htl.html`<p style="color:#8b949e;padding:1rem">No data for this category.</p>`;

  const width  = 760;
  const barMaxW = 420;
  const rowH   = 28;
  const labelW = 280;
  const height = rows.length * rowH + 60;

  const xScore = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,5]).range([0, barMaxW]);
  const xTPS   = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain([0, d3.max(rows, d=>d.avg_tps)*1.05])
    .range([0, 120]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width).attr("height", height)
    .style("font-family","-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif")
    .style("overflow","visible");

  // Column headers
  svg.append("text").attr("x", labelW + barMaxW/2).attr("y",14)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#8b949e")
   .text("Avg Score  (1–5)");
  svg.append("text").attr("x", labelW + barMaxW + 80).attr("y",14)
   .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#8b949e")
   .text("TPS");

  rows.forEach((r, ri) => {
    const y = 24 + ri * rowH;
    const bh = rowH - 6;

    // Alternating bg
    if (ri % 2 === 0) {
      svg.append("rect").attr("x",0).attr("y",y-1)
       .attr("width",width).attr("height",rowH)
       .attr("fill","rgba(255,255,255,0.015)").attr("rx",2);
    }

    // Model label
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", labelW - 8).attr("y", y + bh/2 + 4)
      .attr("text-anchor","end").attr("font-size",10.5)
      .attr("fill", service_colors[r.service])
      .text(r.label.substring(0,42));

    // Score bar
    const sw = xScore(r.avg_score);
    svg.append("rect")
      .attr("x",labelW).attr("y",y+1).attr("width",sw).attr("height",bh-2)
      .attr("rx",2).attr("fill",service_colors[r.service]).attr("opacity",0.75);
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", labelW + sw + 5).attr("y", y + bh/2 + 4)
      .attr("font-size",10).attr("fill","#e6edf3")
      .text(r.avg_score.toFixed(2));

    // TPS mini bar
    const tw = xTPS(r.avg_tps);
    svg.append("rect")
      .attr("x", labelW + barMaxW + 20).attr("y",y+1)
      .attr("width",tw).attr("height",bh-2)
      .attr("rx",2).attr("fill",service_colors[r.service]).attr("opacity",0.4);
    svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", labelW + barMaxW + 20 + tw + 4).attr("y", y + bh/2 + 4)
      .attr("font-size",9.5).attr("fill","#6e7681")
      .text(r.avg_tps.toFixed(0));
  });

  return svg.node();
}
```
